snippet.title: Evercade - The DOOM Collection - Trailer
snippet.description:
The legendary first-person shooter comes to Evercade!

Fight back against the hordes of hell in DOOM, DOOM II, six official mission packs and a special collection of Deathmatch levels!

All on one physical cartridge that's compatible with all Evercade systems.

Find out more: https://evercade.link/doom

EVERCADE NEXUS DOOM EDITION:

Exclusive design.
Exclusive packaging.
Exclusive collectibles.

Limited to 3,000 units.

Pre-orders open 7 August at 3pm UK via Funstock.
https://evercade.link/m/doom-nexus
